title: Zesty Algerian Beef Cutlet Tagine
description: A savory and aerated one-pot Algerian dish featuring beef cutlet, this recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures, flexitarian-friendly and cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Heat the oil in the clay tajine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef cutlets and cook until they are browned on both sides and cooked through.
Remove the beef from the tajine and set it aside.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the tajine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the tajine and bring it to a boil.
Return the beef to the tajine and add the chopped dried apricots.
Cover the tajine and simmer the mixture over low heat for 10 minutes.
Serve the beef and sauce hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
